g.text: From runs to decisions: the missing system
We can run experiments now. What's missing is a fixed way to choose them and a fixed way to process what comes back.
Today every analysis is a script
an agent runs by hand. Nothing
→ ship it in the next setup or not.
sizes set by budget, not detection
pass, clean pass, stops, parse, loops
Done for probe-03 and the wedge rule.
done for probe-03 + wedge; not routine
parse, loops, stuck, ceiling, taint, drift
write real cost per trial; catch killed jobs;
compare task by task with step 2
Change one thing at a time.
Harness changes go before the baseline,
Why the number of runs matters
• 44 runs at an 18% pass rate → the true rate could be
anywhere from about 7% to about 29% (±11 points)
• to see a +10-point gain reliably: about 277 runs per arm
(95% confidence, 80% power, runs on different tasks);
pairing the same tasks across arms needs fewer
• 4 attempts per task only separates “never” from “sometimes”
Inspect Scout and Docent are the field's
centre; both import Harbor runs. None handle
our continuation files or MiMo's in-text
Sources: AnalysisInventory + SystemMap audits 2026-09-29; Linear HAR-81/91/93/94/96/97/99/100; experiment READMEs (HAR-81/85/90); LANDSCAPE.md. Status as of 17:10Z.
